_readme: General Catalyst's live portfolio: every /portfolio card (Webflow + Finsweet, server pages ?f75a35e2_page=N) joined to its /companies/<slug> page by scratch/pull-site-gc.py. flag_* are the firm's own card flags (Active, IPO, Acquired, Creation, CVF, Seed); 'partners' are the deal investors the card and page name; 'backed_since' is the firm's own year of first backing (an anchor, never a round word). flag_seed is the firm's claim that it backed the company at seed: measured against documented rounds before it may label (COLLECTION.md 5).
